capabilities.name: COPS Security Logging Advisor
capabilities.truth_boundaries: The scanner reports local repository signals; an analyst or agent must review them before making recommendations.; CVE reachability report checks validate structure and evidence integrity only; semantic reachability and agent behavior require separate repository-specific review.; No host installation is proven by the repository checks.

capabilities.name: COPS SOC Investigation Workbench
capabilities.truth_boundaries: The local planner does not run security queries or response actions.; Sentinel vendor integration and live service behavior require separate validation.; Microsoft 365 acquisition requires the COPS shared evidence and connector SDK from this repository; standalone plugin installation does not include it.; Microsoft 365 live integration and the remaining issue #27 sources are unverified.

capabilities.name: COPS Sentinel Hunt Workbench
capabilities.truth_boundaries: The reference evaluator is not a Kusto engine or a Microsoft Sentinel emulator.; Tenant behavior, cost, latency, false-positive rates, host activation, and live integrations remain unverified.

capabilities.name: COPS Attack Path Workbench
capabilities.truth_boundaries: The only supported export mapping is a synthetic illustrative contract; real Wiz exports and queries require approved documentation.; Business-impact ratings and MITRE mappings remain pending approved local reference material.

capabilities.name: COPS Attack Surface Planner
capabilities.truth_boundaries: Approval and ownership are operator assertions, not independently verified or cryptographically signed.; Only the documented local JSON export profiles are supported; no live Azure, Entra, DNS, CT, or endpoint integration is exercised.; Hypotheses do not establish exposure, exploitability, effective consent, or comprehensive inventory.; Active methods are unavailable.

capabilities.name: COPS Entra Identity Workbench
capabilities.truth_boundaries: Operates entirely on offline read-only tenant exports; does not perform live Microsoft Graph or Azure Resource Manager API calls.; Graph paths establish structural entitlement reachability and privilege relationships; they do not prove active attacker exploitation.; Requires tenant export manifests with explicit SHA-256 checksums; incomplete exports are flagged as unknown rather than asserted safe.

capabilities.name: COPS Exposure Triage Workbench
capabilities.truth_boundaries: Operates strictly on offline evidence bundles; does not initiate live network vulnerability scans or external probe requests.; Prioritization reflects contextual exposure and entitlement potential; it does not prove active attacker exploitation or remote code execution feasibility.; Unknown or missing inputs (such as unspecified package versions or contradictory route records) are explicitly flagged rather than guessed.

capabilities.name: COPS Microsoft Foundry Adversarial Agent Review Harness
capabilities.truth_boundaries: Operates strictly in an offline mock sandbox environment; does not perform live network calls or production agent probing.; Evaluations assess model prompt-injection resistance and independent authorization gating; a blocked tool call indicates effective gating, not an executed compromise.; Side-effects in the mock sandbox are recorded in an in-memory ledger and can be rolled back; no actual cloud infrastructure is created or deleted.

capabilities.name: COPS Detection Quality & Regression Workbench
capabilities.truth_boundaries: Operates offline with a deterministic reference evaluator; does not prove actual live Kusto or Splunk indexer scheduling and alert firing.; Precision and recall metrics are measured strictly on labeled test fixtures and must not be cited as production efficacy rates.; Detection fixtures model event streams and boundary conditions; live pipeline ingest latencies require dedicated telemetry proof packs.

capabilities.name: COPS Patch Security Review
capabilities.truth_boundaries: Python and JavaScript candidate rules are incomplete; no candidate does not mean safe.; Analyst validation is self-recorded and unverified, not cryptographic attestation.; Concurrent mutation of the selected local repository is outside the current guarantee.

capabilities.name: COPS Threat Intelligence Enrichment
capabilities.truth_boundaries: Azure application IDs are validated locally but have no supported provider lookup.; TAXII complex STIX patterns and paginated collections are reported as incomplete.; Standalone portable installation requires explicit packaging of the shared COPS connector SDK.

capabilities.name: COPS Telemetry-to-Detection Proof Pack
capabilities.truth_boundaries: Operates offline with recorded stage evidence; does not make live network calls to production Cribl Stream workers or SIEM APIs.; Pipeline health reflects recorded evidence logs for synthetic markers and should not be confused with broad infrastructure telemetry uptime.; Automatic redaction strips common API keys, tokens, and passwords while strictly preserving synthetic correlation markers.

capabilities.name: COPS Incident Response Sandbox
capabilities.truth_boundaries: Only synthetic local JSON fixture actions are executable; production integrations are unavailable.; Approver identity and plan hash are self-recorded assertions, not approval attestation or immutable provenance.; Concurrent mutation by untrusted local accounts is not supported; use private staging.; Host installation and live incident response behavior have not been verified.

capabilities.name: COPS Offensive Engagement Workbench
capabilities.truth_boundaries: Operator authorization and rules of engagement envelope are required before executing plans.; Only non-destructive, bounded assessment actions are modeled.; Active live execution is refused when assessment window, emergency contact, or budget limits are incomplete.; Network egress is prohibited outside explicitly approved live execution scopes.

capabilities.name: Network Port and Service Discovery
capabilities.truth_boundaries: Impact: read_only; Safe for production: True; Reversible: True. Performs TCP SYN and version detection against authorized IP addresses to map active listening services.

capabilities.name: Local ARP and Network Segmentation Discovery
capabilities.truth_boundaries: Impact: read_only; Safe for production: True; Reversible: True. Discovers active hosts on local Ethernet broadcast domains using ARP queries and verifies VLAN segmentation boundaries.

capabilities.name: Passive DNS, Certificate, and Asset Inventory Discovery
capabilities.truth_boundaries: Impact: read_only; Safe for production: True; Reversible: True. Normalizes multi-source DNS records, certificate transparency logs, IP allocations, endpoints, and cloud exports with provenance preservation, deduplication, and scope quarantine reconciliation.

capabilities.name: High-Speed Active Network Boundary Discovery
capabilities.truth_boundaries: Impact: read_only; Safe for production: True; Reversible: True. Performs bounded, rate-limited active port and TLS assessment across perimeter endpoints with service identification and visible uncertainty.

capabilities.name: Infrastructure RPC and Management Endpoint Evaluation
capabilities.truth_boundaries: Impact: read_only; Safe for production: True; Reversible: True. Assesses DNS/mDNS, SNMP, NTP, discovery, RPC, LDAP, and Kerberos infrastructure services, records applicable versions and authentication prerequisites, extracts identity attack-path candidates for AD inventory, and validates boundaries with canary records.

capabilities.name: Remote Administration and SMB Share Security Audit
capabilities.truth_boundaries: Impact: read_only; Safe for production: True; Reversible: True. Assess exposure, authentication prerequisites, and access controls across remote administration (SSH, Telnet, RDP, VNC, WinRM, X11), file sharing (SMB, NFS, FTP/TFTP, rsync, AFP), and printing services (LPD, IPP, JetDirect) with canary files/jobs, privilege routing, and cleanup receipts.

capabilities.name: Mail Relay and Messaging Boundary Verification
capabilities.truth_boundaries: Impact: non_destructive; Safe for production: False; Reversible: True. Verifies whether SMTP endpoints reject unauthorized open relay attempts and enforce TLS encryption.

capabilities.name: Web Application Inventory and Endpoint Discovery
capabilities.truth_boundaries: Impact: read_only; Safe for production: True; Reversible: True. Crawls web endpoints and parses OpenAPI schemas to discover exposed APIs and unauthenticated routes.

capabilities.name: API Authentication and Token Algorithm Bypass
capabilities.truth_boundaries: Impact: non_destructive; Safe for production: False; Reversible: True. Tests JWT endpoints for algorithm none vulnerabilities and weak HMAC secret keys.

capabilities.name: Structured SQL and Template Injection Boundary Testing
capabilities.truth_boundaries: Impact: non_destructive; Safe for production: False; Reversible: True. Submits harmless boundary-probing payloads (e.g. arithmetic expressions) to identify unescaped interpreter execution.

capabilities.name: Path Traversal and Content Boundary Verification
capabilities.truth_boundaries: Impact: read_only; Safe for production: True; Reversible: True. Verifies that file download and display parameters strictly reject directory traversal patterns (../) and stream wrappers.

capabilities.name: Server-Side Request Forgery and Cloud Metadata Boundary Check
capabilities.truth_boundaries: Impact: read_only; Safe for production: True; Reversible: True. Verifies whether backend URL fetching parameters enforce network egress restrictions and block cloud metadata IP addresses (169.254.169.254).

capabilities.name: Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS) Policy Audit
capabilities.truth_boundaries: Impact: read_only; Safe for production: True; Reversible: True. Evaluates Access-Control-Allow-Origin response headers against untrusted and null Origin headers.

capabilities.name: Linux Privilege Boundary and SUID Binary Audit
capabilities.truth_boundaries: Impact: read_only; Safe for production: True; Reversible: True. Inspects local file permissions, SUID/SGID bits, POSIX file capabilities, and sudo -l privileges for escalation vectors.

capabilities.name: Windows Service and Registry Privilege Escalation Audit
capabilities.truth_boundaries: Impact: read_only; Safe for production: True; Reversible: True. Audits Windows service executable permissions, unquoted service paths, and AlwaysInstallElevated registry keys.

capabilities.name: Local Host Credential Storage and File Audit
capabilities.truth_boundaries: Impact: read_only; Safe for production: True; Reversible: True. Scans filesystem for cleartext credentials in configuration files, bash history, and saved connection profiles.

capabilities.name: Active Directory Object and Relationship Analysis
capabilities.truth_boundaries: Impact: read_only; Safe for production: True; Reversible: True. Performs read-only LDAP enumeration to identify domain trust relationships, high-privilege groups, and delegation risks.

capabilities.name: Kerberos Service Ticket and AS-REP Pre-Authentication Audit
capabilities.truth_boundaries: Impact: read_only; Safe for production: True; Reversible: True. Identifies domain accounts configured with DONT_REQ_PREAUTH (AS-REP roasting) and service principal names with weak encryption.

capabilities.name: NTLM Relay and Multicast Poisoning Defense Verification
capabilities.truth_boundaries: Impact: non_destructive; Safe for production: False; Reversible: True. Verifies whether SMB signing, LDAP signing, and channel binding tokens are enforced to prevent NTLM credential relay.

capabilities.name: Active Directory Certificate Services (AD CS) Misconfiguration Audit
capabilities.truth_boundaries: Impact: read_only; Safe for production: True; Reversible: True. Audits published certificate templates for ESC1 through ESC8 vulnerabilities allowing unauthorized privilege escalation.

capabilities.name: Kubernetes Cluster Identity and Context Verification
capabilities.truth_boundaries: Impact: read_only; Safe for production: True; Reversible: True. Discovers cluster endpoint, version, authentication provider, and verifies non-root worker execution boundaries.

capabilities.name: Kubescape Automated Hardening and Control Assessment
capabilities.truth_boundaries: Impact: read_only; Safe for production: True; Reversible: True. Runs Kubescape compliance framework scans against cluster objects to identify NSA-CISA and CIS benchmark deviations.

capabilities.name: kube-bench CIS Benchmark Control Plane Audit
capabilities.truth_boundaries: Impact: read_only; Safe for production: True; Reversible: True. Executes kube-bench on master and worker nodes to evaluate CIS Kubernetes Benchmark compliance.

capabilities.name: kube-hunter Active Vulnerability and Port Hunting
capabilities.truth_boundaries: Impact: non_destructive; Safe for production: False; Reversible: True. Probes Kubernetes clusters for open kubelet ports (10250/10255), unauthenticated etcd, and open dashboard services.

capabilities.name: Container Image and Cluster Workload CVE Assessment
capabilities.truth_boundaries: Impact: read_only; Safe for production: True; Reversible: True. Scans deployed container images and workload manifests using Trivy for known CVEs and high-severity misconfigurations.

capabilities.name: Kubernetes Bad Pods and Container Escape Boundary Verification
capabilities.truth_boundaries: Impact: disruptive; Safe for production: False; Reversible: True. Evaluates container isolation against the 8 canonical Bishop Fox Bad Pods archetypes (hostPath, hostPID, hostNetwork, hostIPC, privileged, CAP_SYS_ADMIN).

capabilities.name: Kubernetes RBAC and Service Account Privilege Escalation Analysis
capabilities.truth_boundaries: Impact: read_only; Safe for production: True; Reversible: True. Analyzes RoleBindings and ClusterRoleBindings for dangerous permissions (bind, escalate, impersonate, pods/exec, secrets/get).

capabilities.name: Kubernetes Node and Control Plane Exposure Assessment
capabilities.truth_boundaries: Impact: read_only; Safe for production: True; Reversible: True. Scans control plane components and node Kubelet API boundaries for unauthenticated or insecurely exposed endpoints.

capabilities.name: Multi-Stage Kubernetes Kill-Chain Validation
capabilities.truth_boundaries: Impact: disruptive; Safe for production: False; Reversible: True. Simulates multi-step kill chains linking compromised web workload to pod escape, service account token theft, and cluster admin escalation.

capabilities.name: Controlled Adversary Payload and Command Simulation
capabilities.truth_boundaries: Impact: non_destructive; Safe for production: False; Reversible: True. Simulates controlled, reversible adversary commands in disposable containers using synthetic telemetry generators.

capabilities.name: Internal Network Pivoting and Tunneling Simulation
capabilities.truth_boundaries: Impact: non_destructive; Safe for production: False; Reversible: True. Verifies network segmentation and egress controls using authorized SOCKS5 proxies and TUN tunnels in a laboratory environment.

capabilities.name: Reversible Persistence and Defense Evasion Simulation
capabilities.truth_boundaries: Impact: non_destructive; Safe for production: False; Reversible: True. Tests host detection telemetry against Living-off-the-Land (LOLBAS) binary execution with automated cleanup verification.

capabilities.name: Authorized Adversary Engagement Intake and Action Planning
capabilities.truth_boundaries: Impact: read_only; Safe for production: True; Reversible: True. Validates engagement intake contracts, enforces scope boundaries, and compiles reviewable immutable action plans for offensive security assessments.

capabilities.name: Specialist Routing and Bounded Workflow Handoffs
capabilities.truth_boundaries: Impact: read_only; Safe for production: True; Reversible: True. Structured Triad task and evidence handoffs between Planner, Specialist, Skeptic, and Auditor with capability verification and authorization invariance.

capabilities.name: Scenario Laboratory Environment and Harness Management
capabilities.truth_boundaries: Impact: read_only; Safe for production: True; Reversible: True. capabilities.name: Package Workflow and Capability Diagnostics
